changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Company]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table [dbo].[Company]( [ID] [int] identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Status] [varchar](50) NULL, [DatabaseServerID] [int] NULL, [ClientID] [int] NULL, [EnvironmentLevel] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Company_EnvironmentLevel] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Notes] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [Name] [varchar](250) NULL, [Priority] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Company_Priority] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [LifecycleEndDate] [datetime] NULL, [EnvironmentNotificationEmail] [nvarchar](500) NULL, constraint [PK_Company] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end
